name: Horizontal Scroll Gallery
use: A carousel List Section pins under the header and vertical scroll slides its cards left, with an accent progress hairline; below 768px it becomes a native swipe row with scroll-snap.
notes: Source is a List Section (Carousel layout): the only native source that already lays cards out in one row wider than the screen (Fluid Engine grids are screen-wide; Gallery sections are image-only and run their own layout). Scroll room = a script-owned aria-hidden spacer appended to the section (removed on teardown); no height on Squarespace elements. Marker goes in the section above, since List Sections take no Code Block. Over the 8 KB budget (9.0 KB unminified) because of two modes (pin / swipe), spacer, hairline and observers. Carousel class names (user-items-list-carousel__slides / __slideshow-holder) and arrow selectors are from 7.1 markup but not yet verified on a live site.
